integrity: The proof is analytic, and the accompanying executable checks are finite, supplemental consistency tests. No independent mathematical audit or petroleum field validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two deterministic independent constant-parameter hyperbolic decline curves; ordered exponents and decline coefficients; both exponent parameters strictly between zero and one. The original Arps paper was not inspected in full, and general quotient-comparison results may provide broader implications.
title: Two distinct rank-reversal thresholds for finite-recovery Arps decline curves
